bibl.title: Papiri Ossirinchiti Eschilei: il frammento della Niobe di Eschilo.

bibl.note: P.S.I. XI, 1208 (= MP3 36; LDAB 100) provides evidence of the use of silence in drama, here showing the pain and grief of a mother who has lost everything.
